registers.name: CTRL
registers.description: Launch, fault clear, interrupt enable, latched fault enable, and basic control bits.

fields.name: LAUNCH
fields.description: One-cycle semantic launch pulse when software writes 1 to an accepted CTRL transaction. The bit self-clears after acceptance.

fields.name: FAULT_CLEAR
fields.description: Host clear / fault-clear semantic. When written as 1, requests fault clear and may also qualify exit from ERROR or fault-latched fallback depending on configuration.

fields.name: IRQ_ENABLE
fields.description: Enables irq_out generation when status conditions are met.

fields.name: ENABLE_LATCHED_FAULT
fields.description: When set, fault conditions latch until host clear is observed.

fields.name: HOST_ABORT
fields.description: Optional host abort semantic. If written high, requests abort/fallback handling for the current transaction.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; reads as zero.

registers.name: TIMEOUT_CYCLES
registers.description: Programmable timeout threshold in cycles for WAIT_RESPONSE supervision.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_CYCLES
fields.description: Maximum number of clock cycles allowed between request issue and valid response acceptance before timeout. Zero may be treated as immediate timeout or implementation-defined minimum depending on synthesis policy, but software should program a nonzero value.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; reads as zero.

registers.name: FRESHNESS_CYCLES
registers.description: Freshness threshold used by validation_guard to reject stale responses.

fields.name: FRESHNESS_CYCLES
fields.description: Maximum acceptable response age in cycles relative to the configured freshness supervision point.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; reads as zero.

registers.name: FLOW_AND_FORMAT
registers.description: Flow velocity, geometry format ID, and model ID fields used by request packaging.

fields.name: FLOW_VELOCITY
fields.description: Flow condition input used as metadata in request packaging.

fields.name: GEOM_FORMAT_ID
fields.description: Geometry format identifier included in the outbound request descriptor.

fields.name: MODEL_ID
fields.description: External DoMINO model identifier included in the outbound request descriptor.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; reads as zero.

registers.name: GEOM_LENGTH
registers.description: Configured geometry stream length and related sequence bookkeeping.

fields.name: GEOM_LENGTH
fields.description: Expected number of geometry beats to accept during capture. Geometry capture terminates on geom_last or when this count is reached.

fields.name: RESERVED_1
fields.description: Reserved; reads as zero.

fields.name: RESERVED_2
fields.description: Reserved; reads as zero.

registers.name: JOB_SEQUENCE
registers.description: Job ID and sequence ID tracking fields used for response correlation.

fields.name: JOB_ID
fields.description: Job identifier used to correlate request and response packets.

fields.name: SEQUENCE_ID
fields.description: Sequence identifier used to detect stale or mis-tagged responses.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; reads as zero.

registers.name: ACT_LIMITS
registers.description: Actuator minimum, maximum, and slew-limit configuration used by safety_logic.

fields.name: ACT_MIN
fields.description: Minimum clamp for act_setpoint.

fields.name: ACT_MAX
fields.description: Maximum clamp for act_setpoint.

fields.name: SLEW_LIMIT
fields.description: Optional maximum step change allowed between accepted commands. A zero value may disable slew limiting depending on implementation policy.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; reads as zero.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Busy, fault, timeout, valid response, and fallback-active status mirror.

fields.name: BUSY
fields.description: Controller is busy with capture, request issue, response wait, validation, or fallback sequencing.

fields.name: FAULT
fields.description: Latched fault indication, if enabled/configured.

fields.name: TIMEOUT
fields.description: Timeout status asserted when WAIT_RESPONSE exceeds cfg_timeout_cycles.

fields.name: VALID_RESPONSE
fields.description: Indicates at least one validated response has been accepted.

fields.name: FALLBACK_ACTIVE
fields.description: Safe fallback posture is active.

fields.name: TRANSPORT_ERROR
fields.description: Transport protocol or handshake error detected.

fields.name: INVALID_RESPONSE
fields.description: Malformed, checksum-failing, incomplete, or otherwise invalid response detected.

fields.name: STALE_RESPONSE
fields.description: Response rejected by freshness/age or correlation gating.

fields.name: GEOM_CAPTURE_DONE
fields.description: Geometry capture completed successfully for the current launch.

fields.name: GEOM_CAPTURE_ERROR
fields.description: Geometry capture encountered an error such as invalid length, malformed keep, or premature/late termination.

fields.name: OUTSTANDING_ACTIVE
fields.description: A request is currently outstanding to the external worker.

fields.name: RESPONSE_PENDING
fields.description: A response is pending and being tracked by the transport/validation path.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; reads as zero.

sources.name: IRQ_OUT
sources.description: Top-level interrupt output. Asserted only when irq enable is set and internal fault/status conditions warrant an interrupt according to the controller policy. Software should treat STATUS bits as the canonical source of cause.

init_sequence: Hold reset_n low, then release it and wait until STATUS.FALLBACK_ACTIVE is high and STATUS.BUSY is low.
Program ACT_LIMITS with valid clamp bounds and optional SLEW_LIMIT.
Program TIMEOUT_CYCLES, FRESHNESS_CYCLES, FLOW_AND_FORMAT, GEOM_LENGTH, and JOB_SEQUENCE.
Program CTRL.ENABLE_LATCHED_FAULT as required by system policy, and set CTRL.IRQ_ENABLE if interrupts are desired.
Stream geometry beats using the dedicated geometry stream, then write CTRL.LAUNCH with a valid host transaction to start the transaction.
polling_sequence: Poll STATUS.BUSY until it deasserts or STATUS.TIMEOUT/STATUS.FAULT/STATUS.INVALID_RESPONSE/STATUS.STALE_RESPONSE/STATUS.TRANSPORT_ERROR asserts.
When STATUS.VALID_RESPONSE asserts, sample actuator outputs and any readback status mirror.
If STATUS.FALLBACK_ACTIVE asserts, keep software in safe posture until the condition clears or host clear is accepted.
irq_sequence: On IRQ_OUT, read STATUS to identify the cause bits.
If a fault is latched or a timeout/invalid/stale/transport error occurred, write CTRL.FAULT_CLEAR and, if needed, reinitialize configuration before issuing a new launch.
Do not re-launch while STATUS.BUSY is high or while a fault is still latched.

consistency_notes: This register map is compatible with DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON and preserves the required top module motor_control_top.
The map uses the abstract 64-bit host register window implied by the spec; no AXI/APB/I2C conversion is introduced.
No new hierarchy, ports, geometry arrays, tensors, or bulk payload interfaces are added.
All fields are defined as firmware-visible control/status semantics only; implementation details such as staging storage remain internal and bounded.
Where wider software concepts exist, they are packed into the 64-bit registers already defined by the spec.
